This tests pasting content with redundant inline style.
You should not see any style attributes except one on the b element and there should be no spans.
| <b>
|   style="font-style: italic;"
|   <em>
|     "hello world"
|   <br>
|   "WebKit"
|   <br>
|   <em>
|     "rocks<#selection-caret>"
|   <br>
